definitions.explanation: A prized fish in Japanese cuisine, especially the red sea bream ({真鯛|まだい}). Considered an auspicious food and traditionally served at celebrations such as New Year, weddings, and other festive occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鯛|たい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: We grilled sea bream for the celebration.

examples.japanese: {鯛|たい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しまって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Sea bream sashimi has firm flesh and is delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尾頭|おかしら}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鯛|たい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: For New Year's, we prepare a whole sea bream with head and tail and celebrate together as a family.

notes:
One of the most culturally significant fish in Japan. The red color and the name's phonetic link to ⟦めでたい→めでたい：17687_medetai⟧ (auspicious) make it the quintessential celebratory food.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鯛|たい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sea bream sashimi)
- {鯛|たい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧ (salt-grilled sea bream)
- {鯛|たい}めし (sea bream rice)
- ⟦{鯛焼|たいや}き→鯛焼き：10363_taiyaki⟧ (fish-shaped pastry, named after the shape)
- {尾頭|おかしら}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鯛|たい} (whole sea bream with head and tail)

PROVERB:
⟦{腐|くさ}って→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{鯛|たい} — Even when rotten, it's still a sea bream. Meaning: something of high quality retains its value even in decline.

USAGE:
The most prized variety is {真鯛|まだい} (red sea bream). {鯛|たい} alone usually refers to {真鯛|まだい}. The word appears in many compound fish names (e.g., {金目鯛|きんめだい}, {黒鯛|くろだい}) even for fish that are not true sea bream.
